title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind as informed by real UFO material

tellings.quote: real in Close Encounters of the Third Kind for example you have crates with TRW and locked on them

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Steven Spielberg's 1977 alien film Close Encounters of the Third Kind, which ends at Devils Tower in Wyoming, borrowed from real UFO material. As an example, he says crates in the film carry the names of the aerospace companies TRW and Lockheed, and he links the film to the UFO researchers J. Allen Hynek and Jacques Vallee. If true, it would mean a famous movie quietly reflected what insiders knew.
